pages.description: Free aggregate calculator for MDCAT, UET, NUST, COMSATS, FAST and PU. Get your aggregate, then see last year's closing merit and where you can get in.
pages.content:
Calculate your aggregate, see where last year's closing merit says you can get in, and open the full merit list for MDCAT, UET, NUST, COMSATS, FAST, PU and more.

Calculators and merit lists are being added university by university, starting with MDCAT. Every number will link to its official source; see how we collect them in our methodology.
